title: Opportunity attack → takeoff → land
description: The real second-Step opportunity subtree plays at the grounded launch contact. After the complete reaction, one uninterrupted body traversal spans the entire jump. Native Step commits and after-values remain authoritative.

title: Lethal opportunity attack → no takeoff
description: A real second-Step lethal reaction leaves the first native Step committed. The visual body stays grounded at launch through death and settlement; its legal endpoint remains the committed native position.

title: Short jump · forward
description: A discovered one-cell jump. The complete body clip spans its airtime and returns to Idle at landing; compare jump-clear for the reverse direction.

title: Long jump · forward
description: A discovered three-cell jump uses one complete body traversal over its longer airtime. Compare jump-long-reverse for the return direction.

title: Long jump · reverse
description: The reverse of the three-cell flat-ground jump. All frames of the same body clip span the full flight and settle into Idle at the native endpoint.

title: Two opportunity attacks → one jump
description: Two actual opportunity subtrees play sequentially at the grounded launch contact. Both complete before one uninterrupted flight; their native event identities, damage and order are retained.

title: Later-step reactor · launch reach limitation
description: The reactor is legally in reach only at the later native Step, beyond melee reach of the visual launch contact. This exposes the current grounded-prefix spatial limitation without moving the reactor or changing native OA eligibility.

description: Native DYING→ALIVE healing commits HP and emits the original Heal number and Revived badge. Both mechanical states use Idle in NeuroClient; there is no authored stand-up clip.

title: Failed saves → death → later revival
description: Native failure/success/critical failure causes death. The original Die body plays once, the corpse persists through real intervening roots, and actual revival restores Idle and 3 HP.

title: Paused death while latest already revived
description: The historical Die animation pauses while latest has already processed actual revival. All four camera views retain identical state and pixels during the pause.

title: Walk → opportunity hit → DYING
description: Actual opportunity damage downs a player using death saves and stops the Step. Original TakeDamage returns to Idle with the Dying badge; Die is reserved for actual death.
